text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the day of the Arima Kinen. Gold City shrugs off compliments about her looks with an air of resignation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Tamamo Cross appears ecstatic in the paddock. This is the showdown she's been craving. But after seeing Gold City's lack of motivation, she grows irritated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City heads into the race all the same, believing that just maybe there's still a chance her reputation can be changed.
